#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll mod = 998244353LL;

vector<ll> fact, revFact;

ll mul(ll x, ll y) {
    ll res = (x * y) % mod;
    return res < 0 ? res + mod : res;
}

ll pow_mod(ll x, ll y) {
    if (y < 0) return 0;
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    if (y % 2 == 1) return mul(x, pow_mod(x, y - 1));
    ll root = pow_mod(x, y / 2);
    return mul(root, root);
}

ll div_mod(ll x, ll y) {
    return mul(x, pow_mod(y, mod - 2));
}

void preFact(int n) {
    fact.resize(n + 1);
    revFact.resize(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        fact[i + 1] = mul(i + 1, fact[i]);
    }
    revFact[n] = div_mod(1, fact[n]);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        revFact[i] = mul(revFact[i + 1], i + 1);
    }
}

ll cmb(int a, int b) {
    if (a < b) return 0;
    if (fact.empty()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "error : factorials has not been calculated!! do [preFact] method\n");
        return 0;
    }
    ll af = fact[a];
    ll bf = revFact[b];
    ll abf = revFact[a - b];
    return mul(mul(af, bf), abf);
}

// Fast input
static char inbuf[1 << 20];
static int lenbuf = 0, ptrbuf = 0;

static int readByte() {
    if (lenbuf == -1) return -1;
    if (ptrbuf >= lenbuf) {
        ptrbuf = 0;
        lenbuf = (int)fread(inbuf, 1, sizeof(inbuf), stdin);
        if (lenbuf <= 0) return -1;
    }
    return inbuf[ptrbuf++];
}

static bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
    return !(c >= 33 && c <= 126);
}

static int skip() {
    int b;
    while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && isSpaceChar(b));
    return b;
}

static int ni() {
    int num = 0, b;
    bool minus = false;
    while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && !((b >= '0' && b <= '9') || b == '-'));
    if (b == '-') {
        minus = true;
        b = readByte();
    }
    while (true) {
        if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
        } else {
            return minus ? -num : num;
        }
        b = readByte();
    }
}

static ll nl() {
    ll num = 0;
    int b;
    bool minus = false;
    while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && !((b >= '0' && b <= '9') || b == '-'));
    if (b == '-') {
        minus = true;
        b = readByte();
    }
    while (true) {
        if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
        } else {
            return minus ? -num : num;
        }
        b = readByte();
    }
}

void solve() {
    int n = ni();
    ll tmp = nl();
    if (n <= tmp) {
        printf("0\n");
        return;
    }
    int k = (int)tmp;
    preFact(400000);
    int limit = n - k;
    ll t = cmb(n, limit);
    ll ans = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    for (int i = limit; i >= 1; i--) {
        ans = (ans + sign * cmb(limit, i) * pow_mod(i, n)) % mod;
        if (ans < 0) ans += mod;
        sign = -sign;
    }
    ans = (ans * t) % mod;
    if (k != 0) ans = (ans * 2) % mod;
    if (ans < 0) ans += mod;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
